chunk.content: Milkfish (Chanos chanos) is reported, together with tilapia, common carp and mud carp, among the less expensive fish used to replace costly fish.
chunk.source_quote: Replacement of costly fish with some less expensive ones, such as tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus), common carp (Cyprinus carpio), milkfish (Chanos chanos), and mud cap (Cirrhinus molitorella), is reported.

source.title: A retail market survey on fish fraud from Southern Italy using DNA barcoding (doi:10.4081/ijfs.2025.13376)
